title: Feature Request: 1M Context with Max Plans in CC
body:
https://www.anthropic.com/news/1m-context

Please give us 1M token context on Max plans (with lower rate limits if needed), I really hate it when a session gets auto-compacted on long horizon tasks
author: amxv

top_comments.author: maxritter
top_comments.body: @amxv Exactly, we need this in CC ASAP, Compaction sucks!
